details:
The world uses VideoTXL (TXL Video Player) for video playback.

Since the recent VRChat update, YouTube playback has become intermittently unreliable. I primarily reproduced the issue on Meta Quest, but PC users in the same instance have observed the same looping behavior.

The behavior is random:

Sometimes a submitted YouTube URL starts normally after the usual loading time and the video plays without any problems.

Other times, the exact same YouTube URL takes unusually long to start. When it finally starts, it plays for approximately 4 seconds and then repeatedly loops those same few seconds.

The same URL can work normally on a later attempt without any changes to the world or the video player.

I have also observed the problem disappear after rejoining the same instance.

I tested different instance types (Private, Friends, Group+ and Public). So far, the problem does not appear to be tied to a specific instance type.

I initially suspected custom microphone/amplification Udon components in the world. I completely disabled those components and rebuilt/tested the world, but the issue still occurred.

The same looping behavior was also observed by other users in the same instance playing on PC.

Expected behavior:

After submitting a YouTube URL, the video should load within the normal amount of time and then continue playing normally.

Actual behavior:

Playback is intermittent. Either the video loads and plays normally, or loading takes unusually long and the video subsequently becomes stuck repeatedly playing approximately the first 4 seconds.

Quest Build: 1886
title: VideoTXL: YouTube videos randomly take very long to start and then loop the first few seconds
